control.name: Independent Production Change Approval
control.description: Production changes must follow documented change control procedures including authorization by authorized parties.

results.recommended_action: No action required. Change is fully compliant.
Reject change. Enforce segregation of duties (SoD) by requiring an independent approver.

findings.message: Implementer and approver are the same individual (SoD violation).

results.recommended_action: Reject change. Approver lacks formal delegation of authority for production changes.

findings.message: Approver is not listed in the authorized delegation matrix.

results.recommended_action: Initiate post-implementation review and enforce pre-deployment gate in CI/CD pipeline.

findings.message: Change was implemented before formal approval timestamp.

results.recommended_action: Request re-upload of integrity-verified evidence artifact (SHA-256).

findings.message: Evidence hash format is invalid (expected 64-char SHA-256 hex).
Evidence is 130 days old (exceeds 90-day validity window).

results.recommended_action: Require immediate retroactive documentation and management sign-off for emergency change.

findings.message: Emergency change lacks documented business justification.

results.recommended_action: Control not applicable outside production environment.
Change status is CANCELLED; evaluation bypassed.
